visa_types.visa_type_name: Tourist Visa (Visa on Arrival / Hayya-based entry)
visa_types.notes: Hukoomi's official visas page confirms visitors from 33 countries with travel arrangements receive a visa on arrival for tourism purposes.
Confirmed on the official Hukoomi visas page: citizens of the 33 approved countries can apply for a one-month Joint Tourist Visa allowing travel between Qatar and Oman.
Listed on the official Hukoomi visas page; valid for 24 hours, used for airport transfers and short stays (e.g., seamen, truck drivers).
Confirmed on the official Hukoomi visas page as one of two business visa types, issued on arrival and extendable.
Official Hukoomi page describes a business visa for expatriate workers/short-term contractual work, valid up to three months, arranged in advance by an approved Qatari company or institution.
Official Hukoomi visas page notes GCC residents of approved professions (and accompanying persons) may obtain a one-month GCC Resident Visit Visa.
Official Hukoomi page dedicated to the Work Residence Permit, required for all newcomers wishing to work and live in Qatar, sponsored by a Qatari employer.
Confirmed via official Hukoomi 'Family Applications Service' and described on the Work Residence Permit page as the visa allowing RP holders to sponsor spouse/children.

Referenced as an Apply for Educational Residence Visa service on the Hukoomi portal (hukoomi.gov.qa) via a secondary source; could not directly confirm the exact URL through search, so source_url is null.

visa_types.visa_type_name: Investor Visa (residency without employer sponsorship for qualifying investors)
visa_types.notes: Official Hukoomi visas page states expatriates who invest in selected business ventures are eligible for residency without employer sponsorship, and that authorized personnel may complete the Investor Visa procedure online.

Confirmed on the official Ministry of Interior (MOI) page describing Law No. 10 of 2018 on Permanent Residence and the Permanent Residence Card Granting Committee. Hukoomi also has a related eligibility-inquiry service (https://hukoomi.gov.qa/en/service/inquire-about-the-eligibility-for-permanent-residency/1000).

visa_types.visa_type_name: Property-Related Residency Permit (real estate investment, QAR 730,000+ / QAR 3,650,000+ for PR benefits)
visa_types.notes: Confirmed on the official Ministry of Justice page: a residency permit without sponsor for real estate purchases of at least QAR 730,000, and permanent-residency-card benefits (health, education, investment) for purchases of at least QAR 3,650,000.
